definitions.explanation: Dealing with each item or person separately rather than as a group. Emphasizes treating things one by one according to their specific circumstances.

examples.japanese: {個別|こべつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We will handle each case individually.

examples.japanese: {個別|こべつ}⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けたい→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}んで→申し込む：02311_moushikomu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Students who want individual instruction, please sign up.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{個別|こべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考慮|こうりょ}して→考慮する：06061_kouryosuru⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This issue needs to be judged taking individual circumstances into consideration.

notes:
Used both as a noun ({個別|こべつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ — individually) and as a modifier ({個別|こべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ — individual). Common in business, education, and administrative contexts where uniform treatment is insufficient.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個別|こべつ}⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧ (individual handling)
- {個別|こべつ}⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧ (individual instruction/tutoring)
- {個別|こべつ}⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧ (individual consultation)
- {個別|こべつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (deal with individually)
- {個別|こべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧ (individual circumstances)
